notes: Capability-focused coding LLM technical report (arXiv:2306.11644, Textbooks Are All You Need). No safety, alignment, refusal, jailbreak, toxicity, bias, honesty, or dangerous-capability section or numeric evals. Brief conclusion note on ethical/social implications and data/model bias is a general research urgency statement, not a claim about phi-1. Appendix B has one anecdotal layout note that the model hallucinates moves in a failure example — not treated as hallucination topic coverage. Skipped all capability results: HumanEval, MBPP, Table 1/2 comparisons, Figure 2.1 scaling bars, unconventional LLM-graded coding problems, and contamination/pruning studies. Related checkpoints phi-1-base and phi-1-small are discussed but not separate seed models; covers only microsoft/phi-1. Paper says the model is released but gives no license name or calendar release date (Table 1 “2023 Jun” is a comparison-table date, not a stated launch date).
